The document contains specifications for temperature transmitters and their associated junction boxes.
Temperature transmitter specifications include calibration range, signal input, output signal, accuracy, and power supply details.
Junction box specifications detail material, dimensions, terminal blocks, and hazardous area classification.
There are five different sizes of junction boxes required with varying capacities for transmitters.
The document includes purchase orders and revisions history.
All internal wiring and labeling between term. blocks and transmitters are by vendor.
Junction box numbers are listed separately.
Analog signal terminal block requires 3 signals plus a blank for the tag.
RTD signal terminal block requires 4 signals plus a blank for the tag.
TC signal terminal block requires 2 signals plus a blank for the tag.
Field input dedicated shield terminal block is required, quantity per vendor pending Abener Teyma approval.
Details for junction box wiring and labeling to be provided by Abener-Teyma later.
Temperature transmitter list includes 40 transmitters with specific temperature ranges and junction boxes.
Burn out high for loss of input signal noted in the document comment.
List contains temperature transmitters for TES Services.
Range of temperatures is from 0 to 100%.
All inputs are RTDs (Resistance Temperature Detectors).
Box label size: 2" x 4".
Note on burn out high for loss of input signal.
List 4 contains temperature transmitters for TES Services.
The range of temperatures is from 32°F to 250°F.
